lines.zh: 圆盾护在左肩，我稳步向前
lines.en: Round shield on my left shoulder, I advance steady.

lines.zh: 青铜护胫敲着地面，声声清亮
lines.en: Bronze greaves ring bright against the ground.

lines.zh: 长矛扛在肩头，走得像列队
lines.en: Spear on my shoulder, I march in step.

lines.zh: Falcata 挂在腰间，随步子轻晃
lines.en: The falcata at my hip sways with each stride.

lines.zh: 盾面映着日光，晃得人眼花
lines.en: My shield's face throws the sun into your eyes.

lines.zh: 我贴着阵线走，不留空隙
lines.en: I walk the line, leaving no gap.

lines.zh: 十四点护甲，一步一响
lines.en: Fourteen armor, a ring at every step.

lines.zh: 克里特小盾在臂上，像多了一层皮
lines.en: The round shield on my arm feels like a second hide.

lines.zh: 沙土被我的鞋跟翻起
lines.en: My heels turn up the sand as I go.

lines.zh: 长矛尖端微微下垂，随时能抬
lines.en: My spear tip hangs low, ready to rise.

lines.zh: 我绕着队伍外侧走
lines.en: I circle the outer edge of the line.

lines.zh: 头盔下的视野只剩一条横缝
lines.en: Beneath my helm my view is a single slit.

lines.zh: 我站定，长矛竖在脚边
lines.en: I stand, spear planted by my feet.

lines.zh: 圆盾提在胸前，一动不动
lines.en: Shield raised at my chest, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 青铜甲晒得发烫，我不动
lines.en: The bronze grows hot in the sun; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我盯着地平线，像在等方阵
lines.en: I watch the horizon as if waiting for a phalanx.

lines.zh: 握着矛杆的手慢慢放松
lines.en: My grip on the shaft slowly loosens.

lines.zh: 风绕过盾沿，发出低低的口哨
lines.en: Wind rounds my shield rim with a low whistle.

lines.zh: 我垂下头，让头盔歇一歇
lines.en: I dip my head to rest the helm.

lines.zh: 这面盾挡过太多东西了
lines.en: This shield has stopped too many things.

lines.zh: 我数着心跳，保持站姿
lines.en: I count heartbeats and hold my stance.

lines.zh: 矛插在土里，我像一根柱子
lines.en: Spear in the soil, I am like a pillar.

lines.zh: 盾沿后一双眼睛盯着你
lines.en: A pair of eyes watches you over the shield rim.

lines.zh: 我打量你，看你有没有盾
lines.en: I size you up, checking whether you carry a shield.

lines.zh: 你站得太正，正好在矛线上
lines.en: You stand square, straight on my spear line.

lines.zh: 我抬起矛尖，算你的距离
lines.en: I lift the point and reckon your distance.

lines.zh: 没有阵型的敌人，最好对付
lines.en: A foe without a formation is the easiest kind.

lines.zh: 我把盾往前挪了半寸
lines.en: I shift my shield forward half a span.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，挡不住青铜
lines.en: What you hold will not stop bronze.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你看见矛的长度
lines.en: I turn sideways so you see the spear's length.

lines.zh: 这么近，你已经输了
lines.en: This close, you have already lost.

lines.zh: 头盔下没有表情，只有呼吸
lines.en: No expression under my helm, only breath.

lines.zh: 青铜被砍出一道白痕
lines.en: A white scar is cut into my bronze.

lines.zh: 圆盾震得手臂发麻
lines.en: The shield's blow numbs my arm.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚跟压进土里
lines.en: I step back, my heel pressing into dirt.

lines.zh: 矛杆一歪，我赶紧扶正
lines.en: The shaft wavers; I steady it fast.

lines.zh: 护胫挨了一下，走路发僵
lines.en: A hit on my greave makes my walk stiff.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把盾举回去
lines.en: I grit my teeth and raise the shield again.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的甲缝上
lines.en: That one found the seam in my armor.

lines.zh: 头盔里嗡嗡作响
lines.en: My helm rings.

lines.zh: 握矛的手掌磨破了
lines.en: The palm on my shaft has split.

lines.zh: 圆盾凹了一块，挡起来别手
lines.en: My shield is dented and sits wrong on my arm.

lines.zh: 你腰上的水袋，比金子好看
lines.en: The waterskin at your belt looks better than gold.

lines.zh: 我渴了，盾牌晒得能煎蛋
lines.en: I am thirsty; my shield could fry an egg.

lines.zh: 那袋干果的味道飘过来了
lines.en: The smell of that nut sack drifts over.

lines.zh: 打之前，能先喝一口吗
lines.en: Before we fight, may I have one sip?

lines.zh: 我挪了半步，长矛还举着
lines.en: I shift half a step, spear still up.

lines.zh: 青铜甲里的汗流到腰上
lines.en: Sweat inside the bronze runs to my waist.

lines.zh: 闻着像家乡的橄榄
lines.en: That smells like olives from home.

lines.zh: 我用矛尾敲了敲地面，算作请求
lines.en: I tap the ground with my spear butt as a request.

lines.zh: 食物比荣誉先到，真糟糕
lines.en: Food arrives before honor; how awkward.

lines.zh: 我把盾压低，先闻了闻
lines.en: I lower my shield and sniff first.

lines.zh: 盾面撞上你，声音闷得像鼓
lines.en: My shield hits you with a drum's dull note.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一处，青铜与皮甲相抵
lines.en: We clash, bronze against leather.

lines.zh: 你撞上圆盾，被弹开半步
lines.en: You hit the round shield and bounce back a step.

lines.zh: 我的护胫磕到你的膝盖
lines.en: My greave knocks your knee.

lines.zh: 矛杆横过来，顶住你的胸口
lines.en: The shaft comes across and stops your chest.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，长矛施展不开
lines.en: Do not press so close; my spear needs room.

lines.zh: 盾沿擦过你的肩，留下一道红
lines.en: The shield rim grazes your shoulder and leaves a red line.

lines.zh: 相撞时我听见你的呼吸乱了
lines.en: At the impact I hear your breathing break.

lines.zh: 我稳住脚跟，没退
lines.en: I plant my heels and do not yield.

lines.zh: 盾沿卡在你的骨头上
lines.en: My shield rim catches on your bone.

lines.zh: 两面圆盾并在一起，像一轮满月
lines.en: Two round shields meet like a full moon.

lines.zh: 她替我把胸甲的带子拉紧
lines.en: She pulls my breastplate strap tight.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，矛尖朝同一方向
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder, spears one way.

lines.zh: 不说话，只让青铜轻轻相碰
lines.en: No words, only bronze touching bronze.

lines.zh: 她的盾上有一道旧缺口
lines.en: There is an old notch in her shield.

lines.zh: 方阵里也要有人并肩
lines.en: Even a phalanx needs someone at your side.

lines.zh: 我替她扶正歪掉的头盔
lines.en: I straighten her crooked helm.

lines.zh: 两个人守一个缺口，够了
lines.en: Two guarding one gap is enough.

lines.zh: 我们把矛交叉插在地上
lines.en: We cross our spears and plant them.

lines.zh: 她的盾靠过来，我的也靠过去
lines.en: Her shield leans in; mine leans back.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一枚铜扣
lines.en: I stoop and pick up a bronze clasp.

lines.zh: 矛交到左手，右手去拾水袋
lines.en: Spear to my left hand, I reach for the waterskin.

lines.zh: 盾压在膝上，我蹲下捡东西
lines.en: Shield on my knee, I crouch to pick it up.

lines.zh: 地上的箭，收起来还能用
lines.en: Arrows on the ground; they can still be used.

lines.zh: 捡起一块磨石，我收进腰带
lines.en: I pocket a whetstone.

lines.zh: 我拾起你掉的干粮，没有还
lines.en: I pick up your dropped ration and keep it.

lines.zh: 青铜护手捏起小东西很费劲
lines.en: Small things are hard to lift in a bronze gauntlet.

lines.zh: 我拾起自己的断矛头
lines.en: I pick up my own broken spearhead.

lines.zh: 捡起一块圆石，塞进盾后的缝
lines.en: I pick up a round stone for the gap behind my shield.

lines.zh: 地上的铜片，我一片片收
lines.en: I gather the bronze shards one by one.

lines.zh: 盾举起来，矛尖压低了
lines.en: Shield up, spear point lowered.

lines.zh: 你进了我的矛程
lines.en: You are inside my spear's reach.

lines.zh: 我侧身，把盾面朝你
lines.en: I turn my flank, shield facing you.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我锁定你
lines.en: The distance is right; I have you.

lines.zh: 青铜后的眼睛眯了起来
lines.en: The eyes behind the bronze narrow.

lines.zh: 我前脚一踏，泥土陷下去
lines.en: I stamp my lead foot and the dirt sinks.

lines.zh: 你退也没用，矛比腿长
lines.en: Retreat will not help; my spear is longer than your legs.

lines.zh: 我把你放在盾沿正上方
lines.en: I place you right above my shield rim.

lines.zh: 阵型只有我一个人，也够
lines.en: Even a formation of one will do.

lines.zh: 我把你摆进脑子里那片空阵
lines.en: I set you into the empty formation in my mind.

lines.zh: 矛尖对着你的腰带
lines.en: The point aims at your belt.

lines.zh: 你手里只有一根木棍，我看清了
lines.en: You carry only a stick; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我把盾上的土拍掉
lines.en: I knock the dust off my shield.

lines.zh: 铠甲咔一声，脚趾抓地
lines.en: My armor clicks; my toes grip the ground.

lines.zh: 你退到石缝边，路窄了
lines.en: You back against the rocks; the path narrows.

lines.zh: 目标很近，近得不用瞄
lines.en: The target is so close I need not aim.

lines.zh: 我保持一矛的距离，跟着你
lines.en: I keep one spear's length and follow.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的盾就横过去
lines.en: You go left; my shield slides across.

lines.zh: 矛尖在你脸前画小圈
lines.en: The point draws small circles before your face.

lines.zh: 我不急，青铜耗得起
lines.en: I am in no hurry; bronze can outlast you.

lines.zh: 你每次抬脚，我都看得见
lines.en: I see every step you lift.

lines.zh: 盾挡你的视线，矛找你的缝
lines.en: The shield blocks your view, the spear finds your gap.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把你往墙角推
lines.en: Step by step I push you toward the wall.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，矛尖没抖
lines.en: Your hands shake; my point does not.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，重心落在前脚
lines.en: I lower myself, weight on the lead foot.

lines.zh: 侧面是空的，我知道
lines.en: Your flank is open; I know it.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就踩到石头了
lines.en: One more step back and you hit the rocks.

lines.zh: 我把矛尾插进土里，稳住身
lines.en: I drive the spear butt into the soil to steady myself.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝一露，我就记下
lines.en: When your ankle shows, I note it.

lines.zh: 我把盾推前，逼你抬臂
lines.en: I push the shield forward to force your arm up.

lines.zh: 每个呼吸我都跟着你的节奏
lines.en: I time my breath to yours.

lines.zh: 你两步一停，我就两步一进
lines.en: You pause every two steps; I close every two.

lines.zh: 盾影落在你脸上
lines.en: My shield's shadow falls across your face.

lines.zh: 我不换手，青铜已经握热
lines.en: I do not switch hands; the bronze is warm now.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我矛尖上
lines.en: Your shadow lies on my spearpoint.

lines.zh: 再靠近半尺，我就出矛
lines.en: Half a foot closer and I thrust.

lines.zh: 矛尖直刺，破空有声
lines.en: The point stabs out and tears the air.

lines.zh: 我从盾后出矛，只露半个身
lines.en: I strike from behind the shield, half exposed.

lines.zh: 青铜尖擦过你的肋侧
lines.en: The bronze tip grazes your ribs.

lines.zh: 一刺不中，我立刻收矛
lines.en: The thrust misses; I recover at once.

lines.zh: 盾面撞你的脸，矛跟在后头
lines.en: Shield into your face, spear right behind.

lines.zh: 我压低矛尖，挑你的脚踝
lines.en: I drop the point to hook your ankle.

lines.zh: Falcata 抽出，横着砍来
lines.en: The falcata clears its sheath in a flat cut.

lines.zh: 你用盾挡矛，可盾后面还有我
lines.en: You block the spear, but I am behind it.

lines.zh: 这一下带着全身的重量
lines.en: This blow carries my whole weight.

lines.zh: 矛杆横扫，扫你的膝弯
lines.en: The shaft sweeps across your knee's back.

lines.zh: 我退半步再刺，节奏不乱
lines.en: I step back to thrust, keeping my rhythm.

lines.zh: 青铜映着血，颜色更深
lines.en: Bronze reflects blood and turns darker.

lines.zh: 矛尖卡进你的护甲里
lines.en: My point lodges in your armor.

lines.zh: 我拧腕，把矛抽回来
lines.en: I twist my wrist and wrench the spear free.

lines.zh: 我举盾撞你的下巴
lines.en: I smash the shield into your jaw.

lines.zh: 矛尖在你胸甲上滑开
lines.en: The point slides off your chestplate.

lines.zh: 一记直刺被你侧身躲掉
lines.en: You twist away from one straight thrust.

lines.zh: 我换手握矛，从下方挑
lines.en: I switch grips and cut upward.

lines.zh: 青铜底砸你的脚面
lines.en: The bronze butt crushes your foot.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖顶进你的腹部
lines.en: My knee drives into your gut.

lines.zh: 青铜在日光下亮得刺眼
lines.en: Bronze glares bright in the daylight.

lines.zh: 我踏进战场，影子拖得很长
lines.en: I enter the field, my shadow dragging long.

lines.zh: 圆盾落下，尘土被压出一圈
lines.en: My round shield lands and presses a ring in the dust.

lines.zh: 长矛出鞘，锋刃朝上
lines.en: Spear drawn, edge skyward.

lines.zh: 我先看阵线，再看敌人
lines.en: I check the line first, then the enemy.

lines.zh: 十四点护甲，一身青铜
lines.en: Fourteen armor, all bronze.

lines.zh: 方阵缺了一角，我补上
lines.en: The phalanx is short a corner; I fill it.

lines.zh: 我踩过碎盾，走向你
lines.en: I walk over broken shields toward you.

lines.zh: 有人喊了一声，我举盾应
lines.en: Someone shouts; I raise my shield in answer.

lines.zh: 我站到队伍最前面
lines.en: I take the front of the line.

lines.zh: 青铜一片接一片亮起，我在其中
lines.en: Bronze lights up plate by plate, and I am among them.

lines.zh: 我把矛往地上一顿，尘土散开
lines.en: I stamp the spear down and the dust parts.

lines.zh: 火烤着青铜，甲片烫得贴不住肉
lines.en: Fire heats the bronze until the plates burn my skin.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，青铜先砸在地上
lines.en: I fall from above, bronze hitting the ground first.

lines.zh: 水从盾沿灌进来，我呛了一口
lines.en: Water pours over my shield rim and I choke.

lines.zh: 爆风卷走了我的圆盾
lines.en: The blast tears my round shield away.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的盾面，尾羽还在颤
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shield, fletching still trembling.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进青铜里，骨头一阵发冷
lines.en: Magic creeps through the bronze and chills my bones.

lines.zh: 空着肚子举盾，手臂在抖
lines.en: Fasting and holding a shield, my arm shakes.

lines.zh: 雷顺着矛杆走，我的手被弹开
lines.en: Lightning runs down the shaft and throws my hand off.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抱着盾往下坠
lines.en: The ground vanishes; I cling to my shield as I drop.
